Built for hotels, lodges and resorts

  • Multiple menus — breakfast, à la carte, room service, bar and kids' menus as separate menu types.
  • Bookings on WhatsApp — table reservations and event inquiries come straight to your front desk number.
  • Listed under hotels in your county and town, plus dish pages like “seafood in Mombasa”.
  • QR menu for rooms and the restaurant — no printing every time prices change.
  • Optional POS for the restaurant: table orders, kitchen status, cash/M-Pesa/card, branded receipts and daily reports.

Set-up in an afternoon

Create the listing with your logo and a cover photo, add menus and prices, opening hours and location. Give your restaurant manager the login and they can maintain it from their phone.
